planets.name: HAT-P-5 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Chasoň with a 2.79-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: HAT-P-5 b was found in 2007 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Chasoň. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2007, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.78847323, pl_radj 1.21, pl_bmassj 0.98

quotes.title: HAT-P-5b
quotes.card: HAT-P-5 b is a transiting extrasolar planet located approximately 1000 light-years away in the constellation of Lyra, orbiting the star HAT-P-5.
quotes.introduction: It is a hot Jupiter with a mass 6% greater than Jupiter and a radius 26% greater than Jupiter, corresponding to a density of 0.66 g/cm3, which is less than water.
